changes.change: pubrel init, add, next, check, prepare, changelog, and tag: version a package by the categories of what changed and record each release as a version of its package publet.
Manifest kinds cargo-workspace (with internal path dependencies), cargo-package, and pyproject.
A reusable GitHub Actions workflow that checks pull requests against the release rules and tags published releases on main.

comment: Changes not yet released. One row per change: category changed or removed (a published interface changed: major), added (a feature: minor), or fixed or security (patch). `pubrel add` appends one; `pubrel prepare` moves them into the package publet.
